developer_quote: PageInit() while holding the extension lock is unnecessary after started to use RBM_ZERO_AND_LOCK - nobody can look at the new page before we release the page lock.
diff_summary: Released extension lock before PageInit because the page lock already provides exclusive protection.
verification_notes: Verifie directement sur le code source C de PostgreSQL (auteur Andres Freund). Deplacement du unlock avant PageInit.
crux_validation_notes: Valide avec succes sur le code C reel de PostgreSQL (hio.c, parent 14f98e0a~1). CRUX a formellement detecte les sites dans RelationGetBufferForTuple() avec le motif exact REDUNDANT.

developer_quote: pg_stat_statements: Avoid some locking during PGSS entry scans. Within a single pgssEntry, stats_since and minmax_stats_since are never modified without holding pgss->lock exclusively, so there is no need to hold an entry's spinlock when reading stats_since and minmax_stats_since.
diff_summary: Shortened spinlock critical section to exclude reading stats_since and minmax_stats_since which are already covered by exclusive pgss->lock.
verification_notes: Verifie directement sur le code source C de PostgreSQL (auteur Michael Paquier / Karina Litskevich).
crux_validation_notes: Valide avec succes sur le code C reel de PostgreSQL (contrib/pg_stat_statements/pg_stat_statements.c, parent 5d4298e7~1). CRUX a formellement detecte le spinlock redondant a la ligne 1367 avec le motif exact REDUNDANT.

developer_quote: Jemalloc: Avoid blocking on background thread lock for stats. Each background thread run may take a long time; avoid waiting on the stats if the thread is active.
diff_summary: Replaced blocking mutex lock with non-blocking trylock when collecting background thread metrics to prevent stats queries from serializing.
verification_notes: Verifie directement sur le code source C de Redis/jemalloc (auteur Oran Agra).
crux_validation_notes: Valide avec succes sur le code C reel de Redis/jemalloc (background_thread.c, parent 2fec7d9c~1). CRUX a formellement detecte 7 verrous inutiles dont background_thread_stats_read() [s36] a la ligne 146.
